posts.title: Three Sisters
posts.description: Horrible conditions. Pouring down with rain, but I thought I'd give it 3 hours on The Pits - must be mad but you can't catch 'em sat at home. And on this occasion it worked out - double #11 at 11lb 12oz . Almost an hour later a second run on my float-ledgered sardine produced pike two - season double #12 at 11lb 11oz . I thought for a moment she was a recapture of the first pike - but diffent fish

posts.title: Marraskuu Buttcrack
posts.description: All set to start my campaign for a big perch from The Wye (with a pike sleeper rod) but the river had other ideas - 3 meters of dirty water. Far from ideal - so a change of plans - to The Pits... Took this float I found on the river last season, it reminds me of the ones my Dad used when I was a kid - so I thought I'd see if I could get a pike on it - plus the name appealled to me. posts.title: Salty Old Seadogs
posts.description: A brief break from the pike. Bristol Channel with Wayne, Steve, Dyl & Mellow. Slow morning with a few doggies and small eels, but we got there in the end; huss, spurs and some good sized eels - great craic. Highlight for me was a new shark species - a spurdog shark.
